info.name: The Beginner Pirate's First Training Session

descriptions.notStarted: I've finally become a Pirate... But I have no idea what I'm supposed to do... I should go to Kyrin, the Pirate Director of Job Advancement.
descriptions.inProgress: Kyrin suggests that I go on a light monster hunt to start training. She wants me to hunt down #r11 pigs#k. There's apparently a lot of pigs near Henesys.. \n\n#o1210100# #r#a21931##k
descriptions.completed: I've hunted down 11 pigs and reported the results to Kyrin. Hehe... That was no sweat!
